packageRules.description: Was the 'dbt' group on pip in BOTH project directories in .github/dependabot.yml (patterns dbt-*, duckdb), weekly, limit 5. Renovate does not need the directory split: one rule covers projects/dbt_python_copy and projects/dbt_duckdb_mssql, and a bump that hits both now lands in one PR instead of the two that were open as #28 and #29.
Was the 'python-data' group on pip in projects/dbt_python_copy (patterns pandas, sqlalchemy, pymssql), weekly, limit 5.
Was the docker-compose ecosystem, weekly, limit 3.
Was the github-actions ecosystem, weekly, limit 3. Grouped into one PR.
